families.description: Our 5W. potentiometer distinguish themselves by the original design of the slider-contact. Its consists of a metallic roller on top of a tangential spring. The ends of the resistor-strip are colloidal-silver painted so, that practically there is no residual resistance.

families.description: Our heavy potentiometers and rheostats are made in the following powers : 15-30-40-60-80-125-250-500 and 1000 Watts. These nominal powers are applicable in good conditions of ventilation. If the installation becomes in closets or closed boxes, where ventilation is insufficient these powers are due to reduce until about 20%. The ceramic core is made of hard non hygroscopic steatite, thus avoiding corrosion due to electrolysis. The core is wound with high quality copper-nickel or chrome-aluminium wire, according to the required ohmic value and power of the winding. Each turn of the winding is hold firmly in place and protected against mechanical damages, by a hard, heat-resistant ceramic cement. This cement coating which resists 900ºC has a fast heat dissipation due to its good heat conductivity and matt radiating surface. The slider is a fine-silver brush, according to the requirements. Besides linear windings, to order we can wind multi/sections windings, according to customer's needs or specifications, in order to provide a non-linear response.

other_facts.fact: Section heading 'PACKED ELECTRIC COILS' (ES catalogue: 'Bobinas encapsuladas'); sub-heading 'GENERAL CONSIDERATIONS'. Coils for electromagnets encapsulated in epoxi resin.
Material: epoxi resin encapsulation (ES catalogue: 'resina de epóxi'). Property quoted: high degree of dielectric rigidity.
Drawing labels 'SMOOTH AXIS' and 'STAGGERED AXIS' (ES catalogue: 'EJE LISO' / 'EJE ESCALONADO'); photograph of four blue encapsulated coils with connection cables.
Cross-check with the ES catalogue (same table 'Bobinas encapsuladas'): the five rows (VA, A-G, Kg) are identical in every cell.

Sub-section 'LAMINATED CORE ELECTROMAGNETS' with variants 'Partially Encapsulation' and 'Complete Encapsulation' (ES catalogue: 'Electroimanes de núcleo toroidal', 'Encapsulado parcial' / 'Encapsulado completo').

Cross-check with the ES catalogue: dimensions (65, 99, 64, 64, 96 / 69, 99, 64, 64, 101) and weights (Kg. 2,635 / Kg. 2,750) are identical in both languages; only the sub-section title differs ('Laminated core' vs 'núcleo toroidal').
Printed page numbers in this PDF range equal the PDF page + 10 (PDF p15 prints 25 ... PDF p28 prints 38). 'page' fields in this file are PDF pages.
Section cover 'WIRE WOUND POTENTIOMETERS & CERAMIC RHEOSTATS' (photograph of a wire-wound potentiometer; ES catalogue: 'Potenciómetros y reostatos'); no technical data.

Section heading '3 AND 5W WIRE WOUND POTENTIOMETERS'; sub-headings '3W Potentiometer', 'Principal Characteristics' and 'TWIN POTENTIOMETER' (ES catalogue: 'Potenciómetros bobinados de 3W y 5W', 'Potenciómetro doble').

3W potentiometer: polyamide 6 with fibreglass (the PDF does not say which part is made of it), hermetic against the dust, tilting slider; UL rating 94V-0; packing box of 25 pcs.; terminals 3.2 x 0,5 mm.
3W potentiometer: stated shaft '12mm shaft (Ø 6mm.)'. In the ES catalogue the equivalent text is garbled ('(8 6mm)'), so the EN text resolves that reading to 'Ø 6mm'.
Twin potentiometer: intended for stereo equipments; variant of the 3W; net weight 40 grs.; packing box of 25 pcs. (ES catalogue adds 'como atenuador' to the stereo use).

Sub-heading '5W POTENTIOMETER'; slider-contact: metallic roller on a tangential spring with hypocycloidal movement over the flat side of the resistor-strip (avoids abrasion of the wire); resistor-strip ends colloidal-silver painted so that there is practically no residual resistance.

5W potentiometer: power rating at 25ºC 5W; linear resistance distribution; resistance range 5 Ω - 50 KΩ; tolerance 6%; standard shaft 40 mm; net weight 40 grs.; temperature increasing at full load 75ºC. The EN text is legible where the ES catalogue text is garbled; values agree with the readable parts of the ES text (6%, 8 kg/cm, 40 mm, 75).

Ceramic rheostats: made in 15-30-40-60-80-125-250-500 and 1000 Watts; derating of about 20% when ventilation is insufficient; core of hard non hygroscopic steatite; ceramic cement resists 900ºC; slider fine-silver brush; multi/sections windings to order for non-linear response. Sub-heading 'CERAMIC RHEOSTATS (Potentiometers)' (ES: 'Reostatos cerámicos').

Table of PC12 ... PC1000 (9 models): header is bilingual ('POTENCIA POWER', 'PESO (KG.) WEIGHT (KG.)', 'GAMA DE VALORES OHMIC VALUES'); note (1) 'Anclaje Mod. PC-1000' with an anchor drawing. Cross-check with the ES catalogue: all 9 rows are identical in every cell.

Terminology EN vs ES (same product, same table): 'Manual Control' / 'Power-assisted control' (EN drawing captions) vs 'Manual' / 'Motor' (ES); table columns 'MANUAL' and 'MOTOR.' are the same in both languages.
Tandem rheostat 'REOSTATO TANDEM DOBLE' (2x250W, 2x500W, 2x1000W): table exists only as an image. Cross-check with the ES catalogue: all 3 rows identical.

Tandem rheostat 'REOSTATO TANDEM TRIPLE' (3x250W, 3x500W, 3x1000W): table exists only as an image. Cross-check with the ES catalogue: all 3 rows identical, including the suspicious A MOTOR. column (see uncertain).

Section cover listing: OPERATING KNOBS; METAL BRACKETS FOR LED; BINDING POST, BANANA SOCKETS & FUSE HOLDERS (the data of the third section lie outside this page range). Photograph of knobs, dials, binding posts and banana sockets.

Operating knobs: tables for BO Series, BO Series Lined, Caps, Ring With Pointers, Nut Covers (all with MOD. TYPE as identifier). Note printed under both BO tables: 'Can be manufactured to order 1/4" in all the models except Type 10'.
Cross-check with the ES catalogue, p24 tables (BO, BO Lined, Caps, Ring With Pointers, Nut Covers): every value is identical; the EN BO 'e' column keeps the Spanish connector in '3 y 4'.
Dials With Pointer, Graded Dials (MOD. TYPE), Startors, BM Series and Matt Caps for BM Series: all values identical to the ES catalogue tables (Startors BOS029 has D = 44 in both languages).
"DF" Knob Series (29DF, 38DF, 61DF) and the 13-row Graded Dials code table (CA0050180 ... CA0160330): all values identical to the ES catalogue.

Section heading 'METAL BRACKETS FOR LED': 3mm (2 drawings), 5mm (2 drawings) [page 27] and 8mm (2 drawings), 10mm (2 drawings) [page 28]; thread labelled 'ROSCA' (Spanish) in the drawings; all dimensions identical to the ES catalogue ('Soportes metálicos para LED').

10mm LED section: drawings labelled 'Portaled 8 Cono Mixto' (thread 'ROSCA 12 / 75') and 'Portaled 10 Cono Mixto' (thread 'ROSCA 10 / 100'), Spanish labels untranslated in the EN catalogue; identical to the ES catalogue.

No prices, no stock data and no operating-voltage or current ratings are given anywhere in this page range (only the breakdown voltage of the potentiometers printed as 'over 1000v.' (3W) and '> 1000v.' (5W) and the 0-230v / 0-250v printed dial scales).

uncertain.item: Unit of A-G, meaning of 'VA' and of 'Kg' in the coil table
uncertain.why: The PDF does not print any unit for A-G, does not say what 'VA' rates (coil power) and gives no electrical data (voltage, frequency, insulation class, temperature). Do not complete with assumptions; proposal for the admin panel: ask the manufacturer.

uncertain.item: Assignment of rows to SMOOTH AXIS / STAGGERED AXIS
uncertain.why: Rows with a value in C (50, 150 and the second 200 VA) and rows with values in D-G (100 and the first 200 VA) probably correspond to the smooth-axis and staggered-axis drawings, but the table does not say so. Not published as data.

uncertain.item: Two '200 VA' rows with identical A, B and Kg
uncertain.why: They differ only in C (30) versus D-G (44, 20, 28, 31). They are named '200 VA (row 4)' and '200 VA (row 5)' only to distinguish them; they are not Torivac references and the PDF does not say whether they are two different products.

uncertain.item: Dimension '200' printed on the smooth-axis drawing
uncertain.why: A dimension labelled 200 appears above the smooth-axis drawing with no legend or unit (it could be a cable length). Not interpreted.

uncertain.item: Wording of the properties ('an optimal magnetic properties' / 'epoxi')
uncertain.why: Kept literal. The ES catalogue says 'aprovechamiento magnético máximo' (maximum magnetic utilisation), which is not the same nuance as 'optimal magnetic properties'; both are source statements, do not harmonise them in the web copy without confirmation.

uncertain.item: Section title 'Laminated Core Electromagnets' versus ES 'Electroimanes de núcleo toroidal'
uncertain.why: The two catalogues name the core differently (laminated vs toroidal). The photograph of the partially encapsulated unit shows a stacked (laminated-looking) core, but the PDF states nothing else. Do not publish a core-type claim until the manufacturer confirms; proposal for the admin panel.

uncertain.item: Dimensions of the two drawings (65, 99, 64, 64, 96 / 69, 99, 64, 64, 101) and weights
uncertain.why: Only positions on the drawing are known (elevation/plan); no legend, unit or electrical data (VA, voltage, force). Weight is printed 'Kg. 2,635' / 'Kg. 2,750' with decimal comma, unlike the 0.450 style of the previous page. Assignment partial = left drawings, complete = right drawings follows the captions' alignment.

uncertain.item: 3W potentiometer 'Resistance range: 5 Ω , to 22 k.'
uncertain.why: The unit after 22 k is not printed (the ES catalogue also reads '22 K'). A reading of 5 Ω to 22 kΩ is consistent with the E-10 series statement, but the PDF does not write it; kept literal, proposal for confirmation before publishing a normalised range.

uncertain.item: 3W potentiometer 'Operating temperature: -20º/+60º' and 'Rotation angle: 280º'
uncertain.why: The temperature unit letter (C) is not printed after the degree signs; the rotation angle is printed 280º. Kept literal; the ES catalogue is garbled for these two lines ('-20%/+60"', '2800') so it cannot confirm them.

uncertain.item: 3W potentiometer drawing dimensions (unlabelled, no unit)
uncertain.why: Front view: 40º and 40º (between the three terminals), 25, 8, 6, 2,5. Side view: 22,5, 6, 8, 12, 6 and the vertical label M10/100. The PDF does not say which element each dimension belongs to or its unit (presumably mm). Only 25 (diameter 25mm) and 12 / 6 (shaft '12mm shaft (Ø 6mm.)') are corroborated by the text. Proposal to review with the manufacturer; not published as data.

uncertain.item: Twin potentiometer drawing dimensions (27, 48, 40, 8, 6, 2,5, 12, M10/100, 40º) versus the 3W (25, 22,5)
uncertain.why: Front view: 40º and 40º, 27, 8, 6, 2,5. Side view: 40 (top dimension), 6, 8, 12, 6, 48 and M10/100. They differ from the 3W drawing (25 and 22,5) although the text says the electrical and physical characteristics are the same as the 3W; the PDF does not resolve the apparent discrepancy (only the net weight differs by statement). Not published.

uncertain.item: Twin potentiometer: resistance range, tolerance, breakdown voltage and angle
uncertain.why: Not given explicitly; the PDF only says its characteristics are 'the same as the mentioned 3W'. Inheriting the 3W values for the twin is an inference and is left as a proposal.

uncertain.item: 5W potentiometer angles printed '264ºC' and '250ºC'
uncertain.why: The PDF prints 'ºC' after both angle values (mechanical 264, electrical 250), which are angles of rotation; the 'C' looks like a typographical error. Kept literal in the data; proposal to normalise to degrees (264º / 250º) only after confirmation.

uncertain.item: 5W potentiometer 'Temperature increasing at full load: 75ºC' and 'Mech. breakdown of the stop: 8 kg/cm.'
uncertain.why: The first is a temperature rise (not an absolute temperature); the second has no further definition (breaking torque of the stop). Kept literal.

uncertain.item: 5W potentiometer drawing dimensions (6Ø, 40, 7, 25, 41)
uncertain.why: Side view labels: 6Ø on the shaft, 40, 7, 25 and 41 (the front view has no numbers). The PDF gives no legend or unit; 40 coincides with 'Standard shaft lenght: 40 mm' and 6Ø is presumably the shaft diameter, while 7, 25 and 41 (probably bushing length, body height and body diameter) are not in the text. Proposal; not published.

uncertain.item: 5W slider description 'metallic roller on top of a tangential spring' versus ES 'rodillo de latón basculante'
uncertain.why: The ES catalogue describes a tilting brass roller; the EN text describes a metallic roller on a tangential spring with hypocycloidal movement. The two descriptions are not equivalent and the ES power line is unreadable. Do not publish 'brass' or 'tilting' for the 5W without confirmation.

uncertain.item: Model codes PC12 ... PC1000 versus the nominal powers '15-30-40-60-80-125-250-500 and 1000 Watts'
uncertain.why: The table gives 9 models and the text 9 powers, but the codes do not match the powers for the first five (PC12, PC25, PC35, PC50, PC75 versus 15, 30, 40, 60, 80). The PDF does not state which model has which wattage, so the number in the code must not be published as watts; proposal to ask the manufacturer.

uncertain.item: Units and letters of the rheostat table
uncertain.why: No unit is printed for A, B, C, D, d, R, L (presumably mm) and the drawing labels only the letters (D, A, B, C, R, d, L, G) without legend; G is printed in degrees; weight column is 'PESO (KG.) WEIGHT (KG.)'. The ohmic range is printed as '5Ω – 10kΩ' etc.

uncertain.item: PC1000 row: R = '(1)' and B = 10; anchor drawing labels 70, 33, R.M6
uncertain.why: Column R of PC1000 contains the note mark '(1)' (Anclaje Mod. PC-1000) instead of a thread (M-10 / M-12 in the other rows) and column B is 10 (the others are 8 or 12). The anchor drawing prints 70 (horizontal), 33 (vertical) and 'R.M6' on a hole, with no unit or legend; the relation of R.M6 to column R is not explained. Values kept as printed (confidence media on that row); anchor values not published.

uncertain.item: PC25 column C = 38 (A = 35, B = 8)
uncertain.why: C is 10, 38, 32, 37, 37, 18, 18, 36, 54 along the table, so PC25 does not follow the trend of its neighbours; it is the same in the ES catalogue, so it is not a transcription error of this extraction, but could be an error of the original. Not corrected.

uncertain.item: Winding wire and slider wording versus ES
uncertain.why: EN: 'high quality copper-nickel or chrome-aluminium wire' and 'fine-silver brush'. ES: 'constantán, nichrom o kantal' and 'escobilla de plata o de cobre-plata pulida'. The materials listed differ (nichrom and copper-silver appear only in ES); do not merge or translate one into the other without confirmation.

uncertain.item: Wording 'powers are due to reduce until about 20%'
uncertain.why: It is not clear whether the reduction is of 20% or down to 20% (the same ambiguity exists in the ES text). Kept literal.

uncertain.item: Tandem double: unit of A-F, '- -' cells and the meaning of the letters
uncertain.why: Table transcribed from the image (220 ppp); no unit printed (presumably mm); C MOTOR. and D MOTOR. are '- -' (no value). The drawings label A-F with no legend; no ohmic range, weight, voltage or current is given and the PDF does not say which PC rheostats are used in each tandem.

uncertain.item: Tandem triple: A MOTOR. = 240, 300, 350 (identical to the tandem double)
uncertain.why: In the triple table A MOTOR. repeats the double's values and is smaller than the triple's A MANUAL (300, 370, 430), the opposite of the double (A MOTOR. 240, 300, 350 larger than A MANUAL 180, 230, 270). It looks like a repeated block in the original; the ES catalogue has the same numbers, so the extraction is faithful. Do not publish A MOTOR. for the triple without manufacturer confirmation.

uncertain.item: Unit of D, e, H, d and meaning of the 'e' column ('3 y 4', '4,6', '4,6,8')
uncertain.why: No unit is printed. In 'e' the values '3 y 4' and '4,6,8' are lists and '4,6' is ambiguous (decimal 4,6 or the list 4 and 6); in other tables the comma is a decimal. Kept literal, not interpreted. The note 'Can be manufactured to order 1/4" in all the models except Type 10' does not say what dimension the 1/4" refers to.

uncertain.item: BO Series and BO Series Lined have identical numeric tables
uncertain.why: Only the photographs differ (the lined version has a black indicator line); the PDF gives no other difference. Both tables are kept as separate families.

uncertain.item: Drawing letters versus table columns (Caps: D, H, e vs D, d, e; Ring With Pointers: F, d, D vs D, e, H; Nut Covers: A, B, C vs A, B, D)
uncertain.why: The table headers are kept as printed; the correspondence between drawing and columns cannot be established. Also, the 'H' values of Ring With Pointers (8,5; 13; 19,5; 28; 36,5) are exactly the 'd' values of the BO Series, so the 'H' header may be a misprint.

uncertain.item: Accessory compatibility (Caps, Ring With Pointers, Nut Covers) with the BO / BM knobs
uncertain.why: The accessories are listed by the same MOD. TYPE numbers as the BO series (10, 15, 21, 30, 38), but the PDF does not state which knob each accessory fits. No 'compatible with' claim should be published; proposal for the admin panel.

uncertain.item: Duplicate values (Dials With Pointer = Graded Dials (MOD. TYPE) = Caps) and Startors BOS029 D = 44
uncertain.why: The three tables repeat 26 / 9,8 / 2,8, 36 / 16 / 2,8, 45 / 21,5 / 2,8 and 55 / 27 / 2,7. MOD. 30 has D = 45 in those tables but D = 44 in Startors (BOS029); the same in the ES catalogue. Transcribed as printed; may be a variant or a misprint.

uncertain.item: BM Series and Matt Caps: 'e' = 4,6,1/4" and drawing label 'd'
uncertain.why: The value mixes a comma list and an inch mark; the PDF does not explain it. The BM drawing labels a dimension 'd' that has no column. Not interpreted.

uncertain.item: "DF" Knob Series: column E
uncertain.why: The sectional drawing labels only A, B and D; column E (15,5 / 17 / 18) has no counterpart in the drawing. Also no material is printed on the page (the ES catalogue calls the series 'Botón Baquelita "DF"').

uncertain.item: Graded Dials (CA codes): code pattern and scales
uncertain.why: Rows CA0115230, CA0115250, CA0115330 and CA0160330 have Ø 116 but codes starting 0115 / 0160 (the other Ø 116 rows start 0116); CA0160330 has angle 328º while its code ends in 330. Scales '0-230v' and '0-250v' (lower-case v) are kept literal; the PDF does not say for which variador models they are meant. Not corrected or associated.

uncertain.item: Language of the table
uncertain.why: The English catalogue keeps Spanish/English mixed headers and values ('Código Code', 'Grabado Printed', 'Gris / Grey'). Kept as printed.

uncertain.item: LED brackets 3mm and 5mm: no reference, dimension meaning and unit
uncertain.why: No code or table: each bracket is identified only by its position on the page. Dimensions read from the drawings: Ø 7 / 2 / 13 and Ø 7 / 3 / 15 (3mm), Ø 10 / 3 / 15 and Ø 9.5 / 3 / 16.5 (5mm), thread 'ROSCA 6/0,75' and 'ROSCA 8/0,75'. The small top vertical dimension and the overall one are interpreted from the drawing only; no unit; the fourth drawing prints '9.5' and '16.5' with a decimal point while the rest of the catalogue uses a comma. Identical to the ES catalogue. A priced, referenced sheet needs the code from the manufacturer's list.

uncertain.item: LED bracket 8mm, second drawing: top vertical dimension without value
uncertain.why: The dimension line of the head is drawn but no number is printed; only Ø 14, 20 and ROSCA 12/0,75 are legible. The missing value is not deduced.

uncertain.item: 10mm LED section: 'Portaled 8 Cono Mixto' / 'Portaled 10 Cono Mixto' and thread notation
uncertain.why: Under the '10mm. LED' heading there is a drawing labelled 'Portaled 8'; it is not stated whether it belongs to the 8mm or the 10mm range or which LED diameter each one takes. The threads are printed 'ROSCA 12 / 75' and 'ROSCA 10 / 100' (a different notation from '12/0,75') and the horizontal dimensions 14 and 16 have no Ø symbol; not interpreted as 0,75 / 1,00.

uncertain.item: Page numbering and scope
uncertain.why: Printed page numbers are the PDF page + 10. This job ends at the LED brackets; BINDING POST, BANANA SOCKETS & FUSE HOLDERS announced on the cover (PDF p23) are outside the range.
